_frozen: 2026-10-11, before any engine change, validation run, smoke run or performance run of this campaign (docs/final_campaign/PREREGISTRATION.md section 1, revised after the pre-freeze adversarial review).
purpose: Timestep gate G-A1 for the two new dynamics of Experiment A (PREREGISTRATION.md section 1.3); harness src/gateway_family_validation.py extended inertly for the seven old dynamics
run_length_rule: em_flat T = 500 / min(lam, 1) t.u. after 10 t.u. burn-in (500 t.u. for lam >= 1); trace stride 0.05/(min(lam,1) h); MALA and em_unbiased lengths unchanged
acf_rule: conditional ACF horizon of the new dynamics >= 6 t.u. absolute; tau read-outs at fixed cuts 0.3125, 1.25, 5 t.u. and the 1/e time

seed_rule.note: dprime = DYNAMICS_ORDER index - 7 (0: shift_lam4, 1: shift_lam16, 2: shift_lam128); k = index in the FIXED list h_candidates (0: 2.5e-5, 1: 1.25e-5)

thresholds: identical to the frozen mechanism gate (configs/equal_budget_v2/gateway_validation.json as enforced by scripts/mechanism/analyze_validation.py)

frozen_x_relaxation_test.x0_note: kappa constant: other x0 are replicates of the same AR(1)
frozen_x_relaxation_test.length: 200 relaxation times = 200/(lam kappa^2) t.u. per chain
frozen_x_relaxation_test.estimators: known mean 0, normalised by the known EM variance; se from the between-chain spread (t_63)
frozen_x_relaxation_test.pass_rule: stationary variance vs (1/(beta kappa^2))/(1 - lam kappa^2 h/2) and ACF at lags l h in {0.25,0.5,1,2}/(lam kappa^2) vs phi^l (phi = 1 - lam kappa^2 h): Holm over the 30 two-sided p, FWER 5 %
frozen_x_relaxation_test.meaning: verifies the y integrator (drift and noise scaling with lam); NOT evidence about coupled relaxation (that is MC1)

registry_rule: new dynamics only via an explicit registry accepted only with --out results/final_campaign/expA/validation; refused for results/mechanism/validation; defaults = the seven old dynamics
multiplicity: all 3-se clauses decided by two-sided p (t_15, 16-group jackknife) with Holm at FWER 5 %: one family for the V1 shifted-fibre mean clauses of the new dynamics per h, one family for their V4 clauses
inertness_test: before any G-A1 run: short chains of each old dynamics bitwise equal at HEAD 189c2408 vs extended harness; settings/seed/ACF-plan identical for all old (dynamics, chain, h, group); analyzer on results/mechanism/validation reproduces summary.json byte for byte apart from its generation timestamp; run_validation --dry-run defaults list exactly the old jobs
